meta.name: Vida 720p
meta.description:
Two Mexican-American sisters from the Eastside of Los Angeles who couldn't be more different or distanced from each other are forced to return to their old neighborhood, where they are confronted by the past and surprising truth about their mother’s identity.

Rated TV-MA · Ended · First aired 6 May 2018 · United States of America · Language: English · 30 min
Studio: Big Beach · Network: STARZ

Not complete. On your server: S1 6/6 | S2 10/10 | S3 not on server

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Circumstances force estranged sisters Lyn and Emma to return to their old neighborhood where they are confronted by their past and surprised by family revelations.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Eddy struggles to connect with the two sisters as Lyn falls into old neighborhood patterns, and Emma searches for a way out.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Emma tries to get a handle on the family business while Lyn creates chaos for them. Eddy withdraws into herself as she mourns Vidalia, and Mari's weakness is revealed.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Lyn escapes the Eastside while market research in the neighborhood leads Emma to open an old wound. Mari is publicly humiliated by someone she trusted.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Still wound up from her encounter with Cruz, Emma struggles to find relief. Luckily, Lyn shows up for her when she needs it most. Mari refuses to be a victim and confronts Tlaloc.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Lyn finally realizes she's messing up Johnny's life, and Emma learns the true value of the bar, but is it too late for Eddy?

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: The bar prepares to host a fundraiser for Eddy's hospital expenses while Emma and Lyn learn the truth behind Vida and Eddy's marriage. Mari questions her life, and an event in the building leaves everyone stunned.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The Vigilantes protest a local real estate agent whom Emma considers using to advertise an available unit in the building, which neighborhood handyman Baco agrees to repair.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Emma accompanies Cruz to an event where Emma meets a charming stranger. Emma gives Mari an opportunity while Lyn meets local councilman Rudy at the gym before hosting the bar's first Loteria night.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Emma monitors Baco's progress with the building repairs while Lyn is forced to confront her past. Mari settles into her new job, and Nico makes a surprise visit to the bar.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: The bar hosts a yard sale. Marcos moves in as a new tenant. Lyn's friendship with Rudy builds as Nelson becomes a threat to the bar.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Lyn is preparing for Music Night at the bar when a relic she had discovered at Don Fulgencio's apartment reveals more information about Vida. Mari questions her future. Nico discovers theft at the bar.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Mari's worlds collide, and Lyn and Marcos devise a plan to get back at Nelson. Emma considers alternative sources of income for the bar.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Emma and Nico head to an after-party to check out a new musical act, and Lyn and Marcos will not be left out. Lyn and Emma's conflict comes to a head.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Nico's past comes back to haunt her. Lyn has a nice - and short - day with Johnny. Rocky convinces Eddy to get a handle on her situation. Emma's frustrations build.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: In the season finale, Lyn rises to the occasion, while Emma remains in her funk. Mari's loyalties are conflicted. Eddy makes a discovery about Vida's past. The sisters unexpectedly stand united.
